item.title: TNR Watch: Pakistan’s Intensifying Campaign of Transnational Repression
item.description: In recent months, the Pakistani government has increased its legal harassment of exiled journalists and dissidents. Additionally, there are signs that UK authorities are treating recent acts of physical intimidation directed against outspoken Pakistani exiles as possible transnational repression.
